title: seneciodes cinereum
intro: Seneciodes cinereum, commonly known as the "threadleaf coralbell", is a perennial plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce stress. The therapeutic actions of Seneciodes cinereum include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
